sources.title: AiiDA 1.0, a scalable computational infrastructure for automated reproducible workflows and data provenance
sources.need: Trace how a result was generated and distinguish recorded functions from durable workchains
sources.proposed_function: Bind source, result and independent validator identity; separately design a durable owner for restart claims
sources.acceptance_oracle: Frozen source/output/validator mutations must refuse stale acceptance; separately inject crashes at effect/receipt boundaries
sources.priority: P0 for binding; P1 for separately authorized runtime
sources.limitations: Historical AiiDA findings are not OpenDot throughput, recovery or scientific validation

sources.title: Software Developed at Brookhaven Lab Could Advance Synchrotron Science Worldwide
sources.need: Interoperate with domain tools and observe real scientists' workflow constraints
sources.proposed_function: One bounded adapter workflow and an actual observed unaided-user comparison
sources.acceptance_oracle: Same accepted-output quality in both workflows; preserve assistance, all attempts, active effort and elapsed time when real sessions occur
sources.limitations: First-party account, not a controlled study; no transferred OpenDot adoption or ROI

sources.title: SLSA v1.2 Build: Provenance
sources.need: Verify artifact delivery identity and distinguish trusted identity from self-declared metadata
sources.proposed_function: Exact source/artifact/builder binding with independently established expected pins and authorized provenance verification
sources.acceptance_oracle: Reject wrong source, subject digest, builder identity and missing required trusted expectations
sources.limitations: No SLSA-level claim, signed provenance, complete SBOM or scientific acceptance from an unsigned local manifest
